title: JAPAN RAIL PASS 7-day Ordinary price
content: The adult 7-day Ordinary JAPAN RAIL PASS is ¥50,000 on the official online price table. Overseas Exchange Orders purchased by 30 September 2026 are also ¥50,000; overseas Exchange Orders purchased from 1 October 2026 are ¥53,000. Preserve the purchase-channel caveat when stating the October change.
